content.text: A collaboration involving NASA, India's space agency ISRO, the European Space Agency (ESA), and SpaceX has resulted in Ax-4, a commercial flight run by the private Houston-based company Axiom Space.
Only the second Indian to travel to space is Group Captain Shukla, whose journey occurred 41 years after cosmonaut Rakesh Sharma's flight on a Russian Soyuz in 1984.
